# Stoker

> Launch a coin on Solana priced in the asset you pick: SOL, a stablecoin, a tokenized stock or any asset Raydium quotes. Coins trade on Raydium LaunchLab, then in a Raydium pool with locked liquidity. Creators receive half of what the platform collects on their coin's trades. Stoker never holds funds or keys; every transaction is signed in the user's wallet.

Coins launched here are speculative and can lose all their value. Not offered in the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada or sanctioned countries.

## Pages
- [Explore coins](https://stoker.markets/coins)
- [Stoke a coin](https://stoker.markets/launch)
- [Assets to pair with](https://stoker.markets/assets)
- [Holder rewards](https://stoker.markets/rewards)
- [Stats and the public ledger](https://stoker.markets/revenue)
- [Fees](https://stoker.markets/fees)
- [Risk disclosure](https://stoker.markets/risk)
- [API reference](https://stoker.markets/api)

## API (no key needed to read)
- GET https://api.stoker.markets/v1/platform: addresses, Graduation Target, every fee and rate
- GET https://api.stoker.markets/v1/quotes: every asset a coin can be paired with, with risk labels
- GET https://api.stoker.markets/v1/launches?sort=market_cap|new|trending|graduation: the coins
- GET https://api.stoker.markets/v1/launches/{mint}: one coin
- GET https://api.stoker.markets/v1/stats: coins launched, graduated, 24h volume
- GET https://api.stoker.markets/v1/revenue and /v1/ledger: the platform's books
- POST https://api.stoker.markets/v1/trades/prepare: an unsigned buy or sell for your wallet to sign
